I’ve raised German Shepherds for years and the one thing nobody tells you is that you can’t force two dogs to bond. You can introduce them, train them together, feed them side by side — but the real partnership? They build that themselves. Through shared routines, quiet moments and years of learning each other’s habits without anyone teaching them. The strongest bonds I’ve ever witnessed on my property were never planned. They just happened one day at a time. Just like the best human relationships. And then sometimes they happen a little faster than expected.
